name: Sir James Wates
current_role: Former chairman of Wates Group (2013-May 2023); member of the Wates family that owns the construction group
profile: Sir James Wates CBE is a fourth-generation member of the family behind Wates Group, the UK's large family-owned construction and property company. He joined in 1983 as a management trainee, joined the board in 1997 and chaired the group 2013-2023 before handing over to his cousin Tim Wates. He was knighted in 2019 for services to business and charity.
interesting_fact: He was knighted in the Queen's Birthday Honours 2019 for services to business and charity; he has also chaired the CBI Construction Council and the BRE Trust.
deep_cut_fact: He started working on Wates housing sites in 1975, aged 15, during summer holidays, and says of himself: 'I'm very much a builder... There's nothing like the smell of wet concrete. I just love it.' The firm traces back to his great-grandfather Edward Wates building a house in Purley in 1897.
notes: Stepped down as chairman at the AGM on 4 May 2023 (source: theconstructionindex.co.uk/news/view/wates-group-leadership-transfer); no current role found. No published personal or press contact found; the Wates website blocked automated fetches. Best route is likely via Wates Group corporate communications (wates.co.uk).

name: Hou Bo-yi
current_role: Chairman, Universal Cement Corp. (環球水泥, TWSE: 1104), Taiwan
profile: Hou Bo-yi (侯博義) is a grandson of Tainan Group elder Hou Yu-li, whose family fortune is tied to Tainan Spinning and the wider Tainan Group. He took over management of Universal Cement in 2008, a company founded in 1959 by Wu San-lien and Hou Yu-li, and has run it with his sons, who are credited with turning it from losses to profits.
interesting_fact: Universal Cement, which he chairs, was founded in 1959 by Wu San-lien and his grandfather Hou Yu-li, and holds Taiwan's top market share in gypsum board.
interesting_fact_source: https://www.tatlerasia.com/the-scene/people-parties/家族企業的背後那份世代傳承的侯式精神縱橫談環球水泥集團侯智元侯博義侯智升專訪
deep_cut_fact: The Hou family motto handed down from his grandfather Hou Yu-li is '一分實力做一分事' ('do only as much as your real strength allows'). He is described as reserved and rarely gives long media interviews.
deep_cut_fact_source: https://www.tatlerasia.com/the-scene/people-parties/家族企業的背後那份世代傳承的侯式精神縱橫談環球水泥集團侯智元侯博義侯智升專訪
notes: Taiwanese, though Hurun lists him under China. His brother Hou Bo-ming (侯博明) ran Tainan Spinning (businesstoday.com.tw 2007). Company spokesperson per cnyes: 楊宗仁. ucc@ucctw.com is the company's general email, not a personal one. He is very private.

name: Zhong Xuanxuan
current_role: Individual shareholder of Nongfu Spring (9633.HK); no operating role found
profile: Zhong Xuanxuan (钟䁢䁢) is an elder sister of Nongfu Spring founder Zhong Shanshan. Nongfu Spring's 2020 Hong Kong IPO prospectus lists her as a shareholder and associate of Zhong Shanshan. She bought shares with personal funds in 2007-2008 and became a public shareholder when the company listed in September 2020.
interesting_fact: She was one of 27 individuals who became Nongfu Spring shareholders in 2007-2008, more than a decade before the bottled-water company's 2020 IPO made her brother China's richest man.
notes: Private individual whose wealth comes from a passive shareholding; no public profile or contacts found. Any approach would have to go through Nongfu Spring's corporate channels, and she is unlikely to be a suitable guest.

name: Wang Dengming
current_role: Director (6th board, nominated Dec 2024) and co-controlling shareholder, Maccura Biotechnology (迈克生物, 300463.SZ)
profile: Wang Dengming (王登明) is a founding shareholder of Chengdu-based in-vitro diagnostics maker Maccura Biotechnology. With Tang Yong and Liu Qilin he is one of the company's controlling shareholders under an acting-in-concert agreement. He was formerly a director and commercial director, and in Dec 2024 was nominated to the 6th board, where he sits on the strategy and nomination committees.
interesting_fact: In the 2009 promoter-shareholder table in Maccura's articles of association, Wang held 13.04% (5.72m shares), making him the third-largest of the founding individual shareholders.
deep_cut_fact: Before the current board term, Maccura filings described him as the company's 商务总监 (commercial director) as well as a director and one of its actual controllers.
notes: Low public profile; no interviews or personal contacts found. The commercial-director title comes from the search-result summary of the 2019 SZSE filing; I did not open the PDF directly. Approach via Maccura's board secretary / IR office (listed in its SZSE filings).

name: Janet Hoyle
current_role: Co-founder (former) of Card Factory; no current executive role found
profile: Janet Hoyle co-founded the UK greetings card chain Card Factory with her husband Dean Hoyle. They started selling wholesale cards in 1993, opened their first shop in 1997 and grew it past 500 stores before selling it to Charterhouse for £350m in April 2010. Neither is now involved with the retailer. Dean Hoyle is chairman of Huddersfield Town AFC.
interesting_fact: The couple sold Card Factory to Charterhouse in 2010 for £350 million, when it operated 480 stores, 13 years after opening their first shop.
deep_cut_fact: Before Card Factory, from 1993 she and Dean bought greetings cards wholesale and sold them from the back of their van at car boot sales in the Wakefield area, opening their first shop in 1997.
notes: Rich List entry is shared with Dean Hoyle, who is the public face: he chaired Huddersfield Town from 2009-2019 and again from 2022 (per Wikipedia). Janet keeps a low profile and has no published contacts. Any approach is best made through Dean Hoyle / Huddersfield Town.

name: Ma Jun
current_role: Chairman, Leysen Jewellery / 莱绅通灵 (formerly Tesiro 通灵珠宝, 603900.SH): elected Jan 2022, still chairman in a July 2023 report
profile: Ma Jun (马峻; Hurun spells it 马俊) comes from a jewellery-trade family and is a controlling shareholder, with his wife Man Yize (蔄毅泽), of Nanjing-based Leysen Jewellery, formerly Tesiro. He was unanimously elected chairman in January 2022. He leads a 500+ store brand built on its 'royal heritage', the patented Blue Flame True Heart diamond cut and a Smurfs IP tie-up.
interesting_fact: Under him, Leysen's 蓝火真心钻 (Blue Flame True Heart diamond), which uses a patented cut with a heart shape on the base, won 'jewellery of the year for craftsmanship' at Best of the Best 2022. In May 2022 the brand also issued an NFT version billed as the first digital wedding ring from a high-end jeweller.
deep_cut_fact: His stated view on young buyers: '年轻一代…对传统品牌有很强的包容力，他们更青睐兼具品质、文化、潮流的产品和品牌' (the young generation is very open to traditional brands and prefers products that combine quality, culture and trend).
notes: The Hurun 'shared with Man Yize' is his wife 蔄毅泽 (nbd.com.cn / lanjinger 2021-22 reports). He became the controlling party in 2021-22 after a contested change of control; avoid that topic. The 10jqka page in 2024 was unreadable, so his current chairmanship needs checking. The company website is corporate, not personal.

name: Prashant Mehta
current_role: Former managing director, Rajesh Exports Ltd. (MD from 1 Feb 1995; retired 3 Dec 2022)
profile: Prashant Mehta co-founded Bangalore gold jewellery maker Rajesh Exports with his brother Rajesh Mehta. They grew it from a small garage workshop into one of India's largest companies, and in 2015 it bought Swiss gold refiner Valcambi for $400m. He was MD from 1995 until he retired in December 2022; Rajesh Mehta remains executive chairman.
interesting_fact: In 2015 Rajesh Exports bought Valcambi, which Wikipedia calls the world's largest gold refiner, for $400 million; the company ranked 7th on the Fortune India 500 in 2020.
deep_cut_fact: He and his brother started out making jewellery in a small garage workshop in Bangalore with about ten workers, and opened their first retail outlet by 1990.
notes: Retirement confirmed by the NSE filing RAJESHEXPO_03122022200300_RelIntimationMDresignation.pdf ('desired to retire'). No personal contacts found. In 2026 SEBI made fraud allegations against Rajesh Exports, per Wikipedia; this is a sensitive topic to keep in mind for outreach.

name: Richard Walters
current_role: Director, G. Walters (Holdings) Limited, the holding company of the Walters Group (Hirwaun, South Wales), since Oct 2006
profile: Richard John Walters is a director of G. Walters (Holdings), the holding company of the Walters Group. The construction, civil engineering, opencast mining and land remediation business was founded in the early 1980s by Gweirydd 'Dai' Walters, with whom the Rich List entry is shared. The group says it runs the UK's largest heavy plant fleet, and it is preparing the Global Centre of Rail Excellence site on the former Nant Helen opencast mine.
interesting_fact: Walters Group says it runs the largest heavy plant fleet in the UK, with over 600 items of construction, mining and material-handling equipment. It was appointed to prepare the site for the Global Centre of Rail Excellence on the former Nant Helen opencast mine.
deep_cut_fact: The group's founder, Dai Walters, began in the 1960s as a plant fitter at an opencast coal mine before starting his own company in the early 1980s.
notes: Directorship verified on Companies House (company 02686054 officers page). His exact family relationship to Dai Walters is not stated in the sources read, so it is not asserted. The deep-cut fact is about the founder; I took it from a search summary of that URL and did not open the page itself. Low public profile.

name: Yan Juneng
current_role: Non-employee-representative supervisor, Wens Foodstuff Group (温氏股份, 300498.SZ) (per 2023 annual report, published Apr 2024)
profile: Yan Juneng (严居能), born 1964, is a long-time Wens insider who joined the predecessor of the Guangdong pig and poultry giant in 1983. He rose to regional company general manager and business-division vice president, and was among Wens's top-50 individual shareholders before its listing. He now sits on Wens's supervisory board and is a supervisor of Guangdong Yuncheng Investment Holding.
interesting_fact: He joined the predecessor of Wens in 1983 with a technical-school (中专) education and rose to vice president of a business division at what became one of China's largest livestock companies.
deep_cut_fact: He is a council member (理事) of the Guangdong Xinxing County Beiying Charitable Foundation (广东省新兴县北英慈善基金会).
notes: Low-profile insider; dsh@wens.com.cn is the Wens board office (董事会) email from the annual report. His role may have changed after the 2024 governance changes; check the latest report.
